resources.string: Mac relay is not set up. Pair it in Settings → Phone control.
Cannot reach the Mac relay. Check that the Mac is on, the relay is running and both are on the same network.
The Mac relay no longer accepts this phone. Pair again.
The relay on the Mac is paused. Run dsh-relay resume on the Mac.
The Mac cannot reach this phone. Update the wireless debugging address, or plug in USB.
This phone has not authorised the Mac yet. Tap Allow on the phone.
The phone is locked. Unlock it to continue.
The pairing code is wrong, expired or was tried too often. Run dsh-relay pair on the Mac again.
The saved Mac pairing can no longer be read. Pair again.
The phone could not save the pairing (the system key store is unavailable); nothing was left on the Mac. Try again later.
The relay showed a different certificate than the one paired. Nothing was saved.
Write the Mac address as IP:port, for example 192.0.2.10:8731.
Write the wireless debugging address as IP:port, for example 192.0.2.20:46225.
Pair with the Mac relay first.
